conditions.evidence: the classification of seizures according to the criteria of the International League Against Epilepsy
conditions.label: seizures

output.population: 14 epileptic patients: 9 males aged 25-71 and 5 females aged 20-58.
output.summary: Video-EEG recordings of epileptic patients from a neurology and neurophysiology unit, sampled at 512 Hz with 10-20 electrode placement; most recordings also include EKG. Diagnosis and seizure classification by an expert clinician.
